controls:
Move with WASD or arrow keys.
Escape pauses the game.
unsaved_question: Apply your changes before leaving settings?
settings_hint: Language saves immediately. Apply saves audio and display changes.
gameover_hint: Keep moving. Give the creeps some space.
content_hint: Enable packages and set priority. Changes apply after restarting the game.
content_unavailable: Content is unavailable until the next successful start.
pending_restart: Restart the game to apply the saved selection.
run_saved: Run saved. Continue restores the complete board, enemies, score and player position.
best_save_failed: Your run ended, but the best score could not be saved: {error}
legacy_layout_reset: This old save has no enemy layout. Continue creates a fresh board with a short protection period.
content_start_failed:
Content could not start. Open CONTENT to repair the selection.
{error}
restore_question:
Restore the original save from before the last repair? The current file will be backed up first.
{backup}
save_restored: Original save restored. Enable its required content before continuing.
legacy_import_question: Import this known base-game save? Its original file will be backed up before adding content metadata.
recovery_question: Required content changed. Re-enable its packages in CONTENT, or repair this save. After backing up the original file, missing enemies are removed and a missing arena is replaced by Original Yard. Valid enemies, score and player position remain.
issue_missing_pack: Required package {id} (saved version {version}) is missing or disabled.
issue_incompatible_pack: Package {id} changed from {old} to {current} without declared save compatibility.
issue_missing_content: Saved content {id} is missing from table {table}.
issue_legacy: This save has no content dependency metadata.
issue_added_pack: Package {id} was added after this save was created.
issue_order: The effective package load order differs from this save.
